pin.locked: too many wrong PINs — PIN commands locked for another {minutes} min
pin.wrong_locked: wrong PIN, cancelled — PIN commands locked for {minutes} min
pin.not_set: TELEGRAM_PIN is not set — PIN commands are disabled
cmd.unknown: unknown command. /help for the command list
cmd.unknown_named: unknown command {cmd}. /help for the command list
help.text:
Commands (manual mode — open positions via REST /api/v1/strategy/proposals with accountId):
/closeall <account> — close all positions of the account (PIN required)
/be <symbol> — move the stop to breakeven
/move <symbol> sl|tp <price> — move SL or TP (PIN required)
/ban <symbol> — add the symbol to the blacklist
/unpause <account> — lift auto-pause (PIN required)
/status — balance per account
/positions <account> — open positions with live PnL
/lang [en|ru] — interface language
msg.VENUE_NOT_CONNECTED: venue of account '{account}' is not connected
msg.VENUE_UNSUPPORTED: venue '{venue}' is not connected in this version
msg.CLOSE_ALL_SENT: close-all sent for {count} position(s), confirmation will come from the poller
msg.POSITION_NOT_FOUND: position not found or not open
msg.PRICE_REQUIRED_FOR_LIMIT: price is required for a limit close
msg.POSITION_ALREADY_CLOSED: position is already closed on the exchange
msg.QTY_BELOW_LOT_STEP: qty {qty} is below the exchange lot step for {symbol}
msg.CLOSE_LIMIT_SENT: limit close order for {qty} {symbol} sent (state={state}), confirmation will come from the poller
msg.CLOSE_MARKET_SENT: market close of {qty} {symbol} sent (state={state}), confirmation will come from the poller
msg.STOP_TYPE_INVALID: type must be sl or tp
msg.PARTIAL_CLOSE_STOPS_NOT_RESCALED: SL/TP were not recalculated after the partial close, check the position's protection: {error}
msg.STOP_MOVE_UNPROTECTED: stop move failed, check the position's protection: {error}
msg.NO_EXCHANGE_FOR_PRICE_CHECK: no connected exchange to check the price — execution cancelled
msg.PRICE_UNAVAILABLE: could not get the current price of {symbol} — execution cancelled
msg.PRICE_DRIFT: price moved away from the proposal: entry={entry} now={now} drift={drift}% (limit 0.5%)
msg.EXCHANGE_UNAVAILABLE_FOR_PRICE: exchange unavailable for the price check — execution cancelled: {error}
msg.ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND: account not found in the registry
msg.ORDER_NOT_FILLED: order did not confirm as FILLED after 5 attempts (state={state})
msg.NOTIONAL_CAP_EXCEEDED: would exceed the account notional cap: open ${open} + reserved (pending limit) ${pending} + new ${added} = ${total} > limit ${limit}
msg.LEVERAGE_CAP_EXCEEDED: would exceed the account leverage cap: resulting notional ${notional} > equity x max leverage ${limit}
msg.LIMIT_ORDER_WORKING: limit order placed on the exchange, waiting to fill
msg.EQUITY_UNAVAILABLE: equity is unavailable or not positive
msg.SL_EQUALS_ENTRY: stop loss equals the entry price
msg.EXCEEDS_ACCOUNT_LIMITS: exchange minimum lot ({qty}, notional ${notional}) exceeds account limit ${limit}
msg.NOTIONAL_EXCEEDS_POSITION_LIMIT: notional ${notional} exceeds the account position limit ${limit}
msg.NOTIONAL_EXCEEDS_LEVERAGE_LIMIT: notional ${notional} exceeds the account leverage limit (equity x maxLeverage ${limit})
msg.ANOMALY_EQUITY: abnormal equity drop {previous} -> {equity} — looks like a demo balance reset, operator confirmation required
msg.POSITION_ADOPTED: {side} {qty} @ {price} — opened directly on the exchange, started tracking it (SL/TP unknown)
msg.MISSING_STOP: position has no stop, auto-recovery failed — manual intervention required
msg.LIMIT_FILLED_NO_STOP: limit order filled ({qty} @ {price}), but no stop found on the exchange — check the position's protection
msg.POSITION_CLOSED_DETECTED: {symbol} closed, PnL={pnl} (since detection, not since open), held {hours}h{minutes}m
msg.NO_EQUITY_DATA: no equity data for today — wait for the minute poller (stage 4)
msg.POSITION_CLOSED_DETECTED_PNL_PENDING: {symbol} closed, PnL pending (since detection, not since open), held {hours}h{minutes}m
